about.title: A Small Hero in a Big World

points.1: Step into the shoes of a brave little Goblin and leap across floating islands and cubic platforms, chasing glittering treasures hidden in every corner of the world.
2: Goblin Jr. Adventure is a 3D platformer made for casual players, reimagining classic arcade mechanics in Unreal Engine 5.
with precise jumps, ingenious traps and rewarding exploration.
3: More than a prototype, it's a complete, polished experience:
persistent saves and checkpoints, a local Top 5 leaderboard, English and Italian localization, and full keyboard and gamepad support,
all built on a hybrid C++ and Blueprint architecture.

points.1: Stylized Traversal: Precise jump mechanics designed for navigating floating cubic environments and avoiding ingenious traps.
points.2: Treasure Hunt: Interactive chests and collectible coins scattered across the levels to encourage exploration.
points.3: Checkpoints & Persistence: A reliable system that tracks player progress and collected loot across sessions.
points.4: End Game Loop: Final scoring system with visual rewards (fireworks) and data cleanup for replayability.

points.1: Hybrid Framework: Core systems developed in C++ (SaveGame, Audio Mixers) and extended via Blueprints for rapid gameplay iteration.
points.2: Local Leaderboard: A dedicated Top 5 ranking system that persists locally, allowing players to compete for high scores.
points.3: Asynchronous Loading: Implementation of real-time loading screens featuring animated Flipbook to ensure smooth transitions.
points.4: Audio Control: Comprehensive Audio Mixer setup for independent management of music, UI sounds, and environmental SFX.

points.1: Advanced Options: Fully functional settings menu including axis inversion, volume controls, and window mode persistence.
points.2: Multi-language Support: Integrated localization framework for English and Italian, switchable via the main menu.
points.3: Input Scalability: Support for both Keyboard/Mouse and Gamepad controllers with dedicated UI feedback.
points.4: VFX Integration: Use of Niagara and Flipbook plugins to enhance visual feedback during key gameplay moments.
